summary:
[reference generation] A ten-second continuous waist-up medium shot shows <Subject 1> practicing a graceful folding-fan dance in a quiet courtyard. She opens the fan, sweeps it across her upper body, and turns her shoulders before finishing with the open fan beside her face.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve her recognizable identity, facial proportions, hairstyle, body proportions, and clothing. Add one folding fan as a dance prop.

detailed_description:
Photorealistic dance footage in a peaceful courtyard with pale stone paving, a wooden doorway, and softly blurred green bamboo. Gentle afternoon daylight illuminates the dancer's face and hands. The performance combines crisp fan movements with flowing arms and relaxed shoulders. Everything plays at natural speed, with no slow motion, frozen poses, or speed ramps.

[Shot 1] The camera holds a steady waist-up medium shot at eye level, leaving generous space beside and above <Subject 1> for her arms and fan. She stands at a slight angle to the lens, matching the character in <Picture 1>. Her right hand holds a closed ivory folding fan by its pivot near her waist. Her left hand rests softly in front of her torso. She looks toward the fan with a calm, attentive expression.

During the first three seconds, she raises the closed fan to chest height and opens it with one quick, controlled movement. The ribs spread into a clean semicircle with a soft snap. Keeping her fingers securely around the pivot, she sweeps the open fan across her chest from right to left. Her eyes follow its path, while her left arm extends outward in a gentle curve to balance the gesture.

From three to seven seconds, she turns her shoulders smoothly into a three-quarter profile. Her right arm guides the fan outward and upward in one continuous arc, keeping it clear of her face. A subtle wrist rotation changes the fan from face-on to edge-on and back, revealing its thin ribs and lightly textured surface. Her left hand follows with a softer counterbalancing motion below shoulder height. Her hair and clothing respond naturally to the turn. The camera keeps the same waist-up framing, with both hands and the entire fan inside the image.

During the final three seconds, she turns her shoulders back toward the camera and brings the open fan beside one cheek, slightly below eye level. Both eyes, her nose, and her mouth remain visible. Her left hand settles near her waist as the right wrist becomes still. Her gaze shifts from the fan to the lens, and a small, composed smile appears. The shot ends on this balanced pose, with the fan fully open and its shape unchanged.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet courtyard ambience, faint bamboo leaves moving in the breeze, one soft fan-opening snap, and light swishes synchronized with the fan movements. No spoken dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:
A restrained instrumental melody with delicate plucked strings and soft flute phrases, supporting the dance without overpowering the natural sounds.
